sourced.name: route-list
sourced.source: composed from 21st.dev parts (research found no single 21st route-race component): rmahammad/streaming-data-rows (id 29368), sean0205/c-radio-group-17 (id 28337), prebuiltui/badge-tag (id 6955); retrieved 2026-10-14 via `21st get`

port.29368: rows insert, re-rank and light up as the stream changes them: Reanimated LinearTransition (spring) for the re-rank, a fade-in of the new value instead of the number morph, shaped skeletons for rows still pricing, loading/empty/error states and reduced motion (100 ms) from its contract
port.28337: each choice is a radio card: whole row pressable, ring + filled dot when picked, accessibilityRole radio inside a radiogroup
port.6955: the 'Best' mark: an inset pill on the accent token with the label in its foreground

deviations: one column list, not a table: Wise compare-sheet layout (plan/research 08-references #1) — logo, name, you receive, delta to best, ETA; fee and facts behind one chevron
no ▲/▼ change glyphs or wash: a route row changes once (checking → quoted), so the light-up (mark opacity 0.38 → 1) carries it
routes Kawase cannot run are never offered: they collapse into one 'Didn't quote' disclosure with their reason
motion/react replaced by react-native-reanimated so one file serves iOS, Android and the web (react-native-web)
token names only (bg-card, border-primary, text-muted-foreground…); values come from the Look lane
sourced.status: built (Stage 2) — shown in /dev/gallery replaying races recorded on Arc mainnet; live via use-route-race.ts once POST /routes/race is mounted
